name: claude-skills-pinned
description: A reviewed subset of oaustegard/claude-skills, pinned at e44f32e (2026-11-10).

plugins.name: declauding
plugins.description: Rewrites prose that reads as model-written into plain technical prose, and checks the rewrite kept the draft's claims. The skill only: upstream's Stop hook (the forced fresh-eyes read) is left out.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Adversarial review of a deliverable before it ships (challenging), and checking that a README or doc's claims about the code are still true (verifying-claims).

plugins.name: code
plugins.description: Symbol-level navigation of a checkout with tree-sitter (tree-sitting), a blast-radius report before a change (assessing-impact), and finding tests that copy a domain by hand (declaring-invariants).

plugins.name: checks
plugins.description: Building verification gates that can be shown to go red (gating), and semi-formal reasoning about patches and faults (reasoning-semiformally).
